capabilities: Display month, 2-month, 6-month, and year calendar views
Show Japanese public holidays, wareki, rokuyo, and kichijitsu
Create or open daily notes by clicking a date
Link existing vault notes to calendar dates
Add, edit, and delete lightweight events with markers and popovers
extras: The manifest states the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Documentation is provided in both English and Japanese, including a changelog. Requires Obsidian 1.8.7+ per the v1.1.4 changelog entry.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in calendar, and existing calendars do not show Japanese public holidays, era names, rokuyo, or auspicious-day cycles.
summary: Sidebar calendar plugin showing month/2-month/6-month/year views with Japanese holidays, wareki, rokuyo, kichijitsu, click-to-open daily notes, note links, and lightweight events.
